title: AI alati: ChatGPT, Claude, Grok i društvo
AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and friends
summary: Karta alata, kako birati i što koji alat radi najbolje.
The tool map, how to choose and what each tool does best.

title: Karta AI alata i kako birati
The AI tool map and how to choose

q: Spojite alat s onim po čemu je poznat.
Match each tool with what it is known for.
pairs: Svestran asistent: projekti, GPT-ovi, duboko istraživanje
Versatile assistant: projects, GPTs, deep research
Dugi dokumenti, pisanje, kôd i Claude Code
Long documents, writing, code and Claude Code
Pretraga weba i objava s X-a u stvarnom vremenu
Search of the web and X posts in real time
Odgovori s navedenim izvorima iz pretrage
Answers with cited sources from search
explain: Mogućnosti se često mijenjaju, pa ih provjeri u službenoj dokumentaciji.
Features change often, so check the official documentation.

q: Trebaš najsvježije informacije s izvorima. Što biraš?
You need the freshest information with sources. What do you pick?
options: Alat s pretragom weba koji navodi izvore
A tool with web search that cites sources
Alat koji odgovara samo iz treninga
A tool that answers only from training
Any of them, they all know everything
explain: Model bez pretrage ne zna nove događaje, a izvori ti omogućuju provjeru.
A model without search doesn't know recent events, and sources let you verify.

q: Jedan alat je najbolji za svaki zadatak.
One tool is the best for every task.
explain: Alati se razlikuju po snagama, pa se bira prema zadatku.
Tools differ in strengths, so you choose by task.

q: Alati s pretragom navode ___ iz kojih su uzeli podatke.
Search-enabled tools cite the ___ they took data from.
explain: Izvore uvijek otvori i provjeri.
Always open and check the sources.

q: Složite kako birate AI alat.
Put the steps of choosing an AI tool in order.
steps: Define the task and data risk
Try the same prompt in both
explain: Usporedba na pravom zadatku vrijedi više od recenzija.
A comparison on a real task beats reviews.

q: Što prvo provjeriti prije unosa podataka firme?
What should you check first before entering company data?
explain: Neki planovi dopuštaju korištenje razgovora za poboljšanje modela, a neki ne.
Some plans allow conversations to be used to improve models, others don't.

q: Koji pristup odabiru je bolji?
Which selection approach is better?
a: I pick the most popular tool.
b: Isti stvarni zadatak isprobam u dva alata.
I try the same real task in two tools.
explain: Vlastiti test pokazuje što radi za tvoj slučaj.
Your own test shows what works for your case.

q: Besplatne i plaćene verzije alata mogu imati različite postavke privatnosti.
Free and paid versions of a tool can have different privacy settings.
explain: Uvijek čitaj uvjete točno za plan koji koristiš.
Always read the terms for the exact plan you use.

q: Spojite ChatGPT funkciju s namjenom.
Match each ChatGPT feature with its purpose.
pairs: Razgovori, datoteke i upute za jednu temu
Chats, files and instructions for one topic
Asistent s vlastitim uputama i znanjem
An assistant with your own instructions and knowledge
Uređivanje teksta ili koda uz razgovor
Editing text or code alongside the chat
Dulje istraživanje weba s izvješćem i izvorima
Longer web research with a report and sources
explain: Funkcije i nazivi se mijenjaju. Princip ostaje isti: kontekst, upute i alati.
Features and names change. The principle stays: context, instructions and tools.

q: Želiš da ChatGPT uvijek piše tonom tvog brenda. Što koristiš?
You want ChatGPT to always write in your brand tone. What do you use?
explain: Trajne upute štede vrijeme i drže ton ujednačenim.
Persistent instructions save time and keep the tone consistent.

q: Privremeni razgovor se ne sprema u povijest i ne koristi memoriju.
A temporary chat isn't saved to history and doesn't use memory.
explain: Korisno za jednokratna pitanja, ali i dalje ne unosi tajne podatke.
Useful for one-off questions, but still don't enter secrets.

q: Funkcija za dulje istraživanje s izvorima zove se Deep ___.
The feature for longer research with sources is called Deep ___.
explain: Izvješće uvijek provjeri na izvorima.
Always verify the report against its sources.

q: Učitaš CSV s kampanjama i tražiš grafikon. Što provjeriš?
You upload a campaign CSV and ask for a chart. What do you check?
options: Da brojke odgovaraju izvornim podacima (uzorak ručno)
That the numbers match the source data (spot-check manually)
Only that the chart looks nice
Nothing, the calculation is always right
explain: Model može pogriješiti u računu ili krivo pročitati stupce.
The model can miscalculate or misread columns.

q: Složite izradu prilagođenog GPT-a.
Put the steps of building a custom GPT in order.
explain: Testiranje na teškim upitima otkriva rupe u uputama.
Testing on tough prompts reveals gaps in the instructions.

q: Koja preinaka je najbolja?
Which rewrite is best?

t: Analiziraj CSV i reci mi sve.
Analyze the CSV and tell me everything.
Ti si marketing analitičar. CSV ima kampanje po tjednima. Izračunaj CPA po kanalu, izdvoji 3 uvida u tablici i navedi koje stupce koristiš.
You are a marketing analyst. The CSV has campaigns by week. Compute CPA per channel, give 3 insights in a table and state which columns you use.
why: Uloga, cilj, metrika, format i provjerljivost.
Role, goal, metric, format and verifiability.
Beauty isn't the goal of the analysis.

explain: Navedi metriku i izlaz, tada rezultat možeš provjeriti.
Name the metric and output so you can verify the result.

q: Što uneseš u ChatGPT uvijek je privatno bez obzira na plan i postavke.
Whatever you enter into ChatGPT is always private regardless of plan and settings.
explain: Privatnost ovisi o planu i postavkama. Provjeri ih.
Privacy depends on the plan and settings. Check them.

q: Spojite funkciju s opisom.
Match the feature with its description.
pairs: Zajednički kontekst i datoteke za temu
Shared context and files for a topic
Zaseban prozor s dokumentom, kodom ili stranicom
A separate window with a document, code or page
Pretraga weba i X-a uz sažetak
Search of the web and X with a summary
explain: Nazivi se razvijaju. Provjeri aktualne mogućnosti u aplikaciji.
Names evolve. Check current features in the app.

q: Trebaš sažeti PDF od 80 stranica. Što je ključno?
You must summarize an 80-page PDF. What is key?
options: Dovoljno velik kontekst i provjera sažetka na izvoru
A large enough context and checking the summary against the source
That the summary is as short as possible
explain: Sažetak može izostaviti ili izokrenuti detalje.
A summary can omit or distort details.

q: Grok može koristiti objave s X-a, pa je koristan za praćenje trendova.
Grok can use posts from X, so it's useful for tracking trends.
explain: Ali objave mogu biti netočne ili pristrane.
But posts can be inaccurate or biased.

q: Zašto ne vjerovati slijepo sažetku trendova s X-a?
Why not blindly trust a summary of trends from X?
options: Objave mogu biti lažne, pristrane ili botovi
Posts can be fake, biased or bots
Because summaries are always too long
explain: Otvori izvorne objave i razlikuj činjenice od mišljenja.
Open the original posts and separate facts from opinions.

q: Projekti u Claudeu drže zajednički ___ i datoteke za jednu temu.
Projects in Claude hold shared ___ and files for one topic.
explain: Dobar kontekst je pola prompta.
Good context is half the prompt.

q: Koji zadatak bolje pristaje Groku?
Which task suits Grok better?
b: Pratiti što se ovaj tjedan govori o našem brendu na X-u.
Track what is said about our brand on X this week.
explain: Praćenje javnog razgovora koristi pristup objavama. Ugovor traži pravnika.
Tracking public conversation uses post access. A contract needs a lawyer.

q: Složite istraživanje trenda.
Put trend research in order.
explain: Poveznice omogućuju drugima da provjere.
Links let others verify.

q: Isti prompt u dva alata može dati različit stil, pa ga vrijedi usporediti.
The same prompt in two tools can give a different style, so it's worth comparing.
explain: Usporedba otkriva koji alat pogađa tvoj glas.
Comparison reveals which tool fits your voice.

title: Napredno promptanje
Advanced prompting
summary: Few-shot, razmišljanje korak po korak, strukturirani izlaz i evaluacija.
Few-shot, step-by-step reasoning, structured output and evaluation.

q: Što je few-shot prompt?
What is a few-shot prompt?
options: A prompt with 2–5 examples of the desired output
explain: Primjeri pokazuju ton i format bolje od opisa.
Examples show tone and format better than descriptions.

q: Few-shot primjeri pomažu modelu uhvatiti ton i format.
Few-shot examples help the model catch tone and format.
explain: Model prepoznaje obrazac iz primjera.
The model recognizes the pattern from examples.

q: Prompt bez ikakvih primjera zove se zero-___ prompt.
A prompt with no examples is called a zero-___ prompt.
explain: Zero-shot je brz, ali manje precizan za stil.
Zero-shot is fast but less precise for style.

q: Što bolje prenosi glas brenda?
Which carries brand voice better?
b: Dva primjera naših opisa pa „napiši treći u istom stilu”.
Two examples of our captions, then “write a third in the same style”.
explain: Model ne zna vaš stil dok ga ne vidi.
The model doesn't know your style until it sees it.

q: Spojite tehniku s opisom.
Match the technique with its description.
pairs: Tko je model u ovom zadatku
Who the model is for this task
An example of what you don't want
explain: Kombiniraj uloge i primjere za najbolji rezultat.
Combine roles and examples for the best result.

q: Koliko primjera je obično dovoljno?
How many examples are usually enough?
options: Nekoliko raznolikih, svi u željenom stilu
A few varied ones, all in the desired style
explain: Previše sličnih primjera model slijepo kopira.
Too many similar examples make the model copy blindly.

q: Složite few-shot prompt.
Build a few-shot prompt.
parts: Ti si copywriter za pekaru „Kruh i sol”.
You are a copywriter for the bakery “Bread and Salt”.
Primjer 1: „Hrskavo do zadnje mrvice.” Primjer 2: „Jutro počinje mirisom.”
Example 1: “Crisp to the last crumb.” Example 2: “Morning starts with the smell.”
Napiši 3 nova slogana u istom stilu za novi kruh od raži.
Write 3 new slogans in the same style for the new rye bread.
Format: a list, each up to 6 words.
explain: Primjeri idu prije zadatka da model zna kamo ciljati.
Examples come before the task so the model knows what to aim at.

q: Model ponekad previše oponaša primjere pa ih treba mijenjati.
The model sometimes copies examples too closely, so rotate them.
explain: Raznolikost primjera daje raznolikiji izlaz.
Varied examples give more varied output.

title: Korak po korak i strukturirani izlaz
Step by step and structured output

q: Što je „razmišljanje korak po korak”?
What is “step-by-step thinking”?
options: Tražiš da model razloži korake prije odgovora
You ask the model to lay out steps before answering
explain: Korisno za logiku, račun i planiranje.
Useful for logic, math and planning.

q: Modelima koji sami razmišljaju uvijek treba dodati „razmišljaj korak po korak”.
Models that reason on their own always need “think step by step” added.
explain: Takvi modeli to rade sami. Jasan cilj i kriteriji važniji su.
Such models do it themselves. A clear goal and criteria matter more.

q: Format koji strojevi lako čitaju, npr. za automatizacije, je ___.
A format machines read easily, e.g. for automations, is ___.
explain: JSON ide u skripte i alate poput Zapiera.
JSON goes into scripts and tools like Zapier.

q: Trebaš tablicu s kolonama ideja, kanal, CTA. Što dodaš u prompt?
You need a table with columns idea, channel, CTA. What do you add?
options: Točno te stupce i zahtjev za Markdown tablicu
Exactly those columns and a request for a Markdown table
explain: Navedi stupce, ne očekuj da ih pogodi.
Name the columns, don't expect it to guess.

q: Složite promptanje složenog zadatka.
Order the prompting of a complex task.
explain: Manji koraci daju stabilniji rezultat.
Smaller steps give more stable results.

q: Spojite format s upotrebom.
Match each format with its use.
explain: Odaberi format prema tome tko ili što čita izlaz.
Choose the format by who or what reads the output.

q: Koja preinaka je najbolja?
Which rewrite is best?
bad: Reci mi koji je najbolji kanal.

t: Usporedi Instagram, LinkedIn i email za B2B uslugu po trošku, dosegu i brzini rezultata. Tablica + preporuka u 2 rečenice uz navedene pretpostavke.
Compare Instagram, LinkedIn and email for a B2B service by cost, reach and speed of results. Table + a 2-sentence recommendation with stated assumptions.

explain: Kriteriji pretvaraju mišljenje u usporedbu.
Criteria turn opinion into comparison.

q: Zahtjev „navedi pretpostavke” pomaže uočiti gdje model nagađa.
Asking to “state assumptions” helps spot where the model is guessing.
explain: Pretpostavke možeš ispraviti prije nego što odluka ode dalje.
You can correct assumptions before the decision moves on.

q: Kako najbolje poboljšavati prompt?
What is the best way to improve a prompt?
options: Promijeni jednu stvar i usporedi izlaze
Change one thing and compare outputs
explain: Jedna promjena po testu pokazuje što je pomoglo.
One change per test shows what helped.

q: Prompt je dovoljno isprobati jednom.
It is enough to try a prompt once.
explain: Izlaz varira, pa testiraj na više primjera.
Output varies, so test on several examples.

q: Popis kriterija po kojem ocjenjuješ izlaz zove se ___.
The list of criteria you score output against is called a ___.
explain: Rubrika čini ocjenjivanje dosljednim.
A rubric makes scoring consistent.

q: Složite evaluaciju prompta.
Order the prompt evaluation.
explain: Ovo je isti princip kao testiranje softvera.
This is the same principle as software testing.

q: Koja evaluacija je bolja?
Which evaluation is better?
b: Ocijenio sam 5 izlaza po rubrici: publika, ton, CTA, duljina.
I scored 5 outputs by rubric: audience, tone, CTA, length.
explain: Rubrika hvata greške koje dojam preskoči.
A rubric catches errors that impressions miss.

q: Spojite problem s potezom.
Match the problem with the move.
pairs: Add an example and tone adjectives
Forbid guessing, ask for uncertainty flags
Stavi važna pravila na početak i ponovi kratko
Put key rules first and repeat briefly
explain: Svaki problem ima ciljani popravak.
Each problem has a targeted fix.

q: Što je meta-prompt?
What is a meta-prompt?
options: Tražiš model da kritizira i poboljša tvoj prompt
You ask the model to critique and improve your prompt
A prompt with lots of emoji
explain: Korisno, ali i prijedloge provjeri testom.
Useful, but verify suggestions with a test.

q: Napišite prompt koji traži 3 varijante LinkedIn hooka i tablicu ocjene po kriterijima.
Write a prompt that asks for 3 LinkedIn hook variants and a scoring table by criteria.

label: Traži 3 varijante
Asks for 3 variants
hint: State exactly how many variants you want.

label: Traži tablicu ocjene po kriterijima
Asks for a scoring table by criteria
hint: Dodaj: „Ocijeni svaku po kriterijima u tablici.”
Add: “Score each by criteria in a table.”

label: Postavlja ograničenje
Sets a constraint
hint: Add a length or what to avoid.

model: Ti si LinkedIn copywriter. Napiši 3 varijante hooka za objavu o AI auditu za voditelje marketinga, svaki do 120 znakova. Ocijeni ih u tablici po kriterijima: jasnoća, radoznalost, korist (1–5). Bez klišeja.

You are a LinkedIn copywriter. Write 3 hook variants for a post about an AI audit for marketing managers, each up to 120 characters. Score them in a table by criteria: clarity, curiosity, benefit (1–5). No clichés.

explain: Traženje kriterija zajedno s varijantama automatski daje evaluaciju.
Asking for criteria alongside variants gives you evaluation for free.

title: Kako AI radi ispod haube
How AI works under the hood
summary: Tokeni, kontekst, RAG, fine-tuning, multimodalnost i agenti.
Tokens, context, RAG, fine-tuning, multimodality and agents.

q: Što je token?
What is a token?
options: Dio teksta koji model obrađuje (riječ ili njezin dio)
A chunk of text the model processes (a word or part of one)
explain: Duljina i cijena često se mjere tokenima.
Length and price are often measured in tokens.

q: Kontekstni prozor ograničava koliko teksta model uzima u obzir odjednom.
The context window limits how much text the model considers at once.
explain: Što je razgovor duži, to se starije upute lakše izgube.
The longer the chat, the easier older instructions get lost.

q: Veća ___ daje kreativnije, nepredvidivije odgovore.
A higher ___ gives more creative, less predictable answers.
explain: Za činjenice biraj nižu, za ideje višu.
Pick lower for facts, higher for ideas.

q: Spojite pojam sa značenjem.
Match the term with its meaning.
pairs: A unit of text the model processes
Najviše teksta koje model vidi odjednom
The most text the model sees at once
explain: Ovi pojmovi objašnjavaju većinu čudnog ponašanja modela.
These terms explain most odd model behaviour.

q: Razgovor je vrlo dug i model zaboravlja upute. Što napraviti?
The chat is very long and the model forgets instructions. What do you do?
options: Sažmi ključno i počni novi razgovor s tim uputama
Summarize the essentials and start a new chat with those instructions
explain: Svjež kontekst s ključnim uputama često je najbolji popravak.
A fresh context with key instructions is often the best fix.

q: Koja temperatura za pravni sažetak?
Which temperature for a legal summary?
explain: Niža temperatura daje predvidljivije odgovore.
Lower temperature gives more predictable answers.

q: API naplaćuje po tokenima ulaza i izlaza.
APIs bill by input and output tokens.
explain: Kratki, jasni promptovi su jeftiniji.
Short, clear prompts are cheaper.

q: Isti sadržaj na hrvatskom često troši više tokena nego na engleskom.
The same content in Croatian often uses more tokens than in English.
explain: Utječe na trošak i na ograničenje konteksta.
It affects cost and context limits.

q: Spojite pristup s time kada ga koristiš.
Match the approach with when to use it.
pairs: Fast and cheap, the first choice
Model dobiva tvoje dokumente pri odgovoru
The model gets your documents when answering
Prilagodba stila ili ponašanja na primjerima
Adapting style or behaviour on examples
explain: Kreni od prompta, pa RAG, a fine-tuning tek kad treba.
Start with prompting, then RAG, fine-tuning only when needed.

q: Chatbot treba odgovarati iz cjenika koji se često mijenja. Što koristiš?
A chatbot must answer from a price list that changes often. What do you use?
explain: Dokumente osvježiš bez ponovnog treniranja.
You refresh documents without retraining.

q: Fine-tuning je najbolji način da modelu dodaš činjenice koje se mijenjaju svaki dan.
Fine-tuning is the best way to add facts that change daily.
explain: Za promjenjive činjenice služi RAG ili pretraga.
RAG or search suits changing facts.

q: RAG je kratica za retrieval-augmented ___.
RAG stands for retrieval-augmented ___.
explain: Dohvaćanje pa generiranje s dohvaćenim tekstom.
Retrieve, then generate with the retrieved text.

q: Složite RAG protok.
Order the RAG flow.
steps: Retrieve relevant chunks for the question
explain: Kvaliteta dohvata odlučuje o kvaliteti odgovora.
Retrieval quality decides answer quality.

q: Što je multimodalni model?
What is a multimodal model?
options: Obrađuje više vrsta ulaza, npr. tekst i slike
It handles several input types, e.g. text and images
explain: Možeš poslati sliku oglasa i tražiti analizu.
You can send an ad image and ask for analysis.

q: RAG potpuno uklanja halucinacije.
RAG completely removes hallucinations.
explain: Smanjuje ih, ali odgovore treba provjeravati.
It reduces them, but answers still need checking.

q: Što isprobati prvo?
What should you try first?
b: Bolji prompt, pa RAG ako treba.
A better prompt, then RAG if needed.
explain: Jednostavnije prvo: jeftinije je i brže.
Simpler first: it's cheaper and faster.

q: Što je AI agent?
What is an AI agent?
options: Model koji u petlji planira, poziva alate i provjerava rezultate
A model that plans, calls tools and checks results in a loop
A person in a call centre
explain: Agent djeluje, a ne samo odgovara.
An agent acts, not only answers.

q: Agent može izvršavati radnje u stvarnim sustavima, pa mu treba ograničiti ovlasti.
An agent can act in real systems, so its permissions should be limited.
explain: Manje ovlasti znači manju štetu pri grešci.
Fewer permissions mean less damage from a mistake.

q: Kad model poziva vanjske funkcije i API-je, to zovemo function ___.
When a model calls external functions and APIs, we call it function ___.
explain: Tako model dobiva podatke i izvršava radnje.
That's how a model gets data and performs actions.

q: Složite petlju agenta.
Order the agent loop.
explain: Petlja se ponavlja dok cilj nije ispunjen.
The loop repeats until the goal is met.

q: Spojite komponentu s ulogom.
Match the component with its role.
explain: Sve četiri komponente čine pouzdanog agenta.
All four parts make a dependable agent.

q: Gdje agent najviše štedi vrijeme u marketingu?
Where does an agent save the most time in marketing?
options: Ponavljajući višekoračni zadaci, npr. prikupi izvještaje, sažmi, pripremi nacrt
Repetitive multi-step tasks, e.g. collect reports, summarize, prepare a draft
explain: Ponavljanje je idealno za automatizaciju.
Repetition is ideal for automation.

q: Koja je postavka agenta sigurnija?
Which agent setup is safer?
a: Pun pristup svemu da ne pita.
Full access to everything so it never asks.
b: Pristup samo potrebnom i odobrenje prije slanja ili brisanja.
Access only to what's needed and approval before sending or deleting.
explain: Odobrenje za nepovratne radnje je zlatno pravilo.
Approval for irreversible actions is the golden rule.

q: Agenta ne treba nadzirati jer je automatiziran.
An agent doesn't need monitoring because it's automated.
explain: Nadzor i logovi hvataju greške rano.
Monitoring and logs catch errors early.
